name: PAMAP2 Physical Activity Monitoring
description: Wearable sensor recordings of 18 physical activities from 9 subjects, collected with three inertial measurement units and a heart-rate monitor.
citation: Reiss, A., & Stricker, D. (2012). Introducing a New Benchmarked Dataset for Activity Monitoring. 2012 16th International Symposium on Wearable Computers, 108–109. https://doi.org/10.1109/ISWC.2012.13
